newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close higher on currency.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close higher on currency.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures closed mostly higher on Monday with the market once again dominated by currency.
In thinly traded markets wheat closed one to 0.85 stg up and barley 0.25 to 0.50 stg higher.
Most active wheat position was March which finshed with a last trade of 95 stg, 0.85 stg up after trading 128 lots.
The biggest mover, January had a last trade of 92.75 stg, but did not trade until half an hour before the close and finished with 30 lots aginst it.
Barley closed with 0.25 to 0.50 stg up after trading 26 lots all within the last half an hour of business.
Most active March closed 0.50 stg up at 93.25 stg with 16 lots traded.
